title: Run EDGAR run: SEC Dissemination in a high-frequency world

scopes.description: Author-documented construction of the SEC disclosure timing and insider-transaction sample, TAQ variables, CRSP filters, and supplementary firm/media analyses; the package supplies step descriptions and a filename-level sample but no executable programs.

requirements.description: Primary/secondary PDS receipt times and SEC post/dissemination times for the reported filings; source records say the author timing data came from a PDS subscriber and exact event timing varies by subscriber.

routes.description: The described author-subscriber files are proprietary. A separate subscriber route or authorized prepared files may be possible, but no access, exact history or millisecond field compatibility was verified.

routes.location: SEC public Feed/Oldloads and current PDS specification
routes.description: SEC pages document public filing archives and the current subscriber format; they do not verify a 2012–2013 public archive of the required subscriber-received timestamps or exact author feed history.
routes.expected_period: Current published specification; historical 2012–2013 feed/vintage not established.

requirements.description: EDGAR indexes and Form 4/Form 4/A filing contents for March 2012–December 2013, including author-needed filing, acceptance and insider/company fields.

routes.location: SEC EDGAR public indexes and filing archives
routes.description: Official SEC indexes cover the required period and document company name, form type, CIK, filing date and filename, with raw full filing text. Parsing acceptance time and insider CIK/name into the author fields remains preparation because no author parser is supplied.
The documented local roots exist, but the bounded top-level check did not match the 4,782 filenames or verify form coverage, section completeness or parsed-field compatibility.

routes.location: SEC EDGAR Feed/Oldloads or author-prepared FTP scrape

requirements.description: Thomson-Reuters Insider Trading Table 1 with the documented transaction, role, date, cleanse, CUSIP, price and share fields.

routes.description: The authors identify an historical WRDS download and exact sample filters. Current access to that historical product/vintage and the required field set are unverified.
The frozen catalog identifies a locally listed Thomson Reuters Table 1 candidate. No bounded readability, field, vintage or sample-coverage probe was performed.

routes.description: The source describes a 2014 download and its CUSIP join, but no current access, historical-vintage or field probe was performed.

The same-run bounded probe confirms a readable local quarterly file and the sampled GVKEY/DATADATE/ATQ/NIQ/REVTQ/XRDQ columns. Its requested fields did not check CUSIP or CIK, and one row does not establish 2014 vintage or required sample history.

requirements.description: Daily TAQ quote and trade files (author CQ/CT), linked to CRSP, for event windows and the 52-week normal-volume construction.

routes.location: WRDS Daily TAQ / licensed NYSE Daily TAQ
routes.description: Official product documentation supports a Daily TAQ archive from 1993 with quote, trade and NBBO file types and licensing by historical month; exact author WRDS CQ/CT interface, event fields and authorized access remain unverified. Exact local TAQ.CQ and TAQ.CT catalog lookups had no matches; no inference about off-catalog WRDS access is made.
routes.expected_period: 1993 onward for NYSE Daily TAQ archive; required events are 2012–2013 and controls extend approximately one year earlier.

requirements.description: CRSP daily stock file (dsf) for bidlo/askhi and CRSP identifiers in the TAQ-CRSP link.

routes.description: The workflow specifies dsf fields and a historical download, but current authorized access, exact vintage and required identifier/field compatibility were not checked.
A same-run one-row probe confirms a readable local daily stock file with PERMNO/DATE/PRC/RET. The required BIDLO/ASKHI fields and historical sample coverage were not checked.
Frozen catalog discovery only; this second daily-stock file was not probed and its field names, history and compatibility are unknown.

requirements.description: Compustat funda total assets, joined by gvkey and acceptance year for supplementary analyses.

routes.description: The required source and join keys are documented; access, period and exact field compatibility remain unverified.

The same-run bounded probe confirms a readable local annual file and the sampled GVKEY/DATADATE/AT fields. The sampled AT value is missing; required vintage, firm-year coverage and compatibility are unresolved.

requirements.description: RavenPack Dow Jones story archive matched to permno/CUSIP and filtered by relevance, story category and time after first dissemination.

routes.description: The authors identify a 2014 archive and document their filters; current access to the same archive vintage and required schema are unverified.
The catalog candidate is RavenPack category metadata, not the required Dow Jones story archive; no story data or field/history compatibility is established.

issues.description: The package contains two PDF descriptions and final_sample.xlsx but no author SAS, Stata or Python program. The data sheet says SAS and Stata programs performed the conversion and analyses; the detailed steps do not provide executable entry points or the table/figure-to-script mapping.

The author describes proprietary PDS subscriber timing with up to millisecond receipt times. The current SEC PDS specification documents acceptance time only at HHMMSS precision and does not establish a public historical subscriber-receipt archive or the exact author data. Access and vintage remain unverified.

final_sample.xlsx is described as 4,782 SEC filenames and its existing one-row probe shows only CIK, file_name and secdate. It is not a verified full analysis panel, so it does not support an analysis_only scope.

The data sheet lists scraped SEC FTP date-times, while the detailed workflow does not specify the FTP file, schema or how those times enter the three-source timing panel. Clarify whether this is a mandatory stage and its producer/consumer order.
SAS 9.4 initialization failed at TKELS in the supplied environment probe. SAS availability and entitlement remain unverified; the failure is not evidence of an absent license.

The workflow names TCLINK and NBBO.sas, but no code is packaged; only TCLINK has a bounded official WRDS page match. NBBO code/version and fit to the documented TAQ quote derivation remain unverified.

Local catalog discovery found readable COMP.FUNDQ, COMP.FUNDA and CRSP.DSF candidates plus TFN.TABLE1 and RPA.RAVENPACK_CATEGORIES metadata candidates. The bounded probes do not verify author-required CUSIP/CIK or BIDLO/ASKHI fields, subscriber vintages or 2012–2013 history; the RavenPack categories table is not the required Dow Jones archive. Exact TAQ.CQ/CT lookups found no catalog match. These findings do not establish absent access or licenses.

Obtain a field/data dictionary and version list for any author-prepared analytical inputs; do not infer a compatible analysis panel from the filename list.
validation: Confirm every reported Table/Figure maps to a supplied executable entry point or documented manual stage.
Verify the final analysis input contains the fields and observations consumed by those entry points.

review_notes: Expanded draft saved after complete reading of the two author PDFs, package member inventory and existing one-row workbook/environment probes, plus bounded SEC-root metadata, exact frozen catalog lookups and official SEC/WRDS/NYSE source pages. No dataset downloads, author code, installations or applied patches were performed.
There are no frozen dependency IDs for this item. The assessment independently covers each source named by the authors and links unresolved data, software and workflow issues to actions.

The SEC index/filing route is verified for public index coverage from 1994Q3 onward and the official raw filing archive. Author-specific parser outputs, sample-level match and the proprietary PDS subscriber timing series remain distinct unresolved inputs.

The NYSE Daily TAQ archive and WRDS TCLINK page are public product/macro leads. Historical license access, WRDS CQ/CT file compatibility, current NBBO.sas and author-specific macro versions remain unresolved. No catalog miss implies absence of licensing.
The bounded local SEC check confirmed only that two documented corpus roots exist. It did not read filings, match filenames or establish period/form/field coverage.
The workbook identifies 4,782 SEC filenames; its supplied one-row probe contains only CIK, file_name and secdate and does not establish a full analysis input. No analysis_only scope is justified.
SAS 9.4 is unverified because startup failed at TKELS. Python 3.12.14 and Stata 18 are available, but author programs are absent. execution_verified remains false.

Common-resource QA update saved: frozen catalog discovery found local Compustat fundq/funda, CRSP dsf/dsf_v2, Thomson Reuters TFN Table 1/2, and RavenPack category metadata candidates; exact TAQ.CQ/CT lookups returned no match. Reused same-run one-row fundq/funda/dsf probes only where exact file paths matched. Missing fields, coverage, archives and vintage remain explicit.
